4.  Provide evidence-based information regarding nutritional needs

Monitoring/Evaluation:
1. Patient weight will stabilize as measured by daily weights.
2.  Caloric intake will increase to a minimum of 65% of current 
recommendations as measured by daily calorie count.
3.  Patient will express tolerance to current food choices during daily 
patient visitations.
4.  Patient will state understanding of current nutritional needs during
chemotherapy and during periods of immunosuppression.
